notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Found 2026-09-10 (session_01AhE6XBx3nRd81aHLQrciQe) by tests/broadr_light_nuclide_pendf_golden.rs after the broadn grid port (op-tubm): H-2 (A=2, 293.6 K, y=sqrt(A E/kT)=0.03 at 1e-5 eV) MT=102 capture vs NJOY tape22, same-energy lin-lin comparison: 1e-5 eV crate 2.484e-2 vs NJOY 2.543e-2 (-2.3%; 0 K value 2.530e-2, a pure 1/v would be invariant), 1.59e-5 eV -2.1%, ~2e-5 eV -1.9%, 3e-5 eV -1.4%, 1e-4 eV -0.17%, 1e-3 eV +0.13%, >1e-2 eV <5e-4. Elastic (flat) at the same energies agrees to <6e-4, so this is the low-y treatment of a 1/v shape: the SIGMA1 integral below the first grid point (NJOY bsigma extends the first panel as 1/v and integrates it analytically; the crate's bsigma_scalar's lower-boundary extension / negative-velocity term at y<1 is the suspect - src/broadr/mod.rs notes the sigma-minus term is only evaluated for y<=4 and that hnabb's Taylor refinement is not implemented). The crate's own unit test broadening_preserves_one_over_v tolerates 1e-2 at interior points, which is the same defect seen from the other side. Read broadr.f90 bsigma (l.1510-1675) and hnabb before changing anything; predicted fix effect: H-2 capture at 1e-5 eV moves from 2.484e-2 to ~2.53-2.54e-2. Not asserted in the golden test (asserted range starts at 1e-4 eV); the full range is printed.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: 2026-09-10 wave 4: ROOT-CAUSED and FIXED (pending push). NOT the lower-boundary extension: bsigma's panel logic is faithful to broadr.f90:1510-1675 line by line. Cause: src/broadr/mod.rs erfc_nonneg was A&S 7.1.26 (1.2e-7 ABSOLUTE error) while upstream uses SLATEC derfc (mathm.f90:447, full double); bsigma's s1/s2 carry 1/y and 1/y^2 weights, so at y=0.03 (H-2, 1e-5 eV) the erfc error is amplified ~1e3. Isolated with a pure-1/v invariance profile (unit test one_over_v_is_preserved_at_low_y): A&S erfc -> -1.94e-2 at y=0.03, -1.68e-2 at 0.04, -9.3e-3 at 0.06, -1.6e-3 at 0.10, +-3-4e-4 at y=1-2 (sign-alternating) -- reproducing the bead's -2.3%/-0.17% profile; precise erfc (series <3, continued fraction >=3, checked to 1e-13 vs reference values) -> flat ~1e-6 (the lin-lin chord of 1/u), 6e-6 worst at y=0.04. Oracle re-measure (broadr_light_nuclide_pendf_golden): H-2 MT=102 full-range worst moved from 2.31e-2 at 1.07e-5 eV to 9.2e-3 at 23 eV (the errmax regime, 1.7e-5 b); Li-6 MT=105 full-range worst 3.7e-3 at 1e-5 eV -> 1.4e-3 at 10.6 keV; all other MTs unchanged within 1e-5. ASSERT_FROM_EV lowered 1e-4 -> 1e-5 (whole range now asserted). Prediction (H-2 capture at 1e-5 eV -> ~2.53-2.54e-2) held.

notes.content: Fixed and pushed (develop 6513de62): erfc to double precision (upstream SLATEC derfc); pure-1/v invariance at y=0.03 from -1.94e-2 to ~4e-6; H-2 capture vs NJOY worst 2.3e-2 at 1e-5 eV -> 9.2e-3 at 23 eV (errmax regime); golden test now asserts from the grid floor.

title: BROADR SIGMA1 kernel: capture ~2% low below 5e-5 eV for H-2 vs NJOY (low-y lower-boundary extension), 1/v not preserved to better than 1e-2

design:
Child epic of the nuclear refinery programme (bn op-upme).

**Fidelity target: Crude estimate now, Engineering model target**

A rigorous MESH crude-column path already exists (`solve_crude_column`,
`CrudeColumnConfig`, `CrudeColumnResult`). **Dogfood and validate it** before
extending.

## Preserve the documented limitation

The crate already states, correctly: *"Atmospheric column only - no vacuum
tower, no pre-flash, no crude furnace, no pump-arounds, and no steam stripping.
It is a teaching and scoping model... not a refinery simulator"* and *"**A real
CDU is not reboiled.** It is a refluxed absorber stripped with open steam at
the bottom, with pump-around circuits removing heat down the column."*

**Do not call the current model refinery-grade merely because it converges.**

## The structural gap is smaller than it looks

`ColumnType::RefluxedAbsorber` **already exists in the solver enum**;
`RigorousColumn::distillation` is simply the only constructor and fixes a
reboiled column. The path to a structurally correct CDU is a constructor plus
steam-stripping and pump-around handling on existing solver machinery -- **not
new solver physics**. Scope that before assuming a rewrite.

## Required eventual outputs

naphtha; kerosene; diesel; atmospheric gas oil where represented; atmospheric
residue; stage profile; condenser duty; furnace/reboiler-equivalent duty;
pump-around duties; stripping-steam demand; conservation report.

Use **~20-50 assay-derived pseudocomponents**, not thousands of molecules.

## Out of scope for this pass (programme-wide)

Do not: port DWSIM UI or graphical flowsheet objects; port CAPE-OPEN unless a
concrete backend requirement exists; reproduce .NET class architecture; make
DWSIM depend on Outram-FOAM; solve thousands of molecular species in the CDU;
implement molecular reconstruction before assay/pseudocomponent CDU works; call
a converged model validated without reference evidence; hide conservation
errors; push to `main`.
title: Refinery: CDU fidelity
